sketches.mechanism: An empty data type has no possible values, and an empty case expression over it is exhaustive; from an impossible argument a function may return any type.
sketches.resonance: The unreachable speaker can promise anything, because no world exists in which the promise must be kept.

sketches.mechanism: Default argument expressions are evaluated once at function definition time, so a mutable default list is shared by every call.
sketches.resonance: What looks like a fresh private place becomes a memory that keeps everything it was ever given.
sketches.draft:
def remember(x, heart=[]):
    heart.append(x)
    return heart

first = remember(1)
second = remember(2)

sketches.mechanism: Signed integer overflow is undefined behavior; exceeding INT_MAX leaves the semantics of the program.
sketches.resonance: At the farthest named number, one more step is not the future but the end of law.
